page_title: CAD 2-2 CEL | Cadiz CF v Celta Vigo 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' The match has just finished.

90+10' 2 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Darwin Machis (Cadiz) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a magnificent shot into the top left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Vicente Guaita, so the score changes to 2:2.
90+8' Cadiz CF work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+5' Juanmi (Cadiz) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' Cadiz CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cadiz CF comes to nothing.
87' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Robert Navarro as he is replaced by Darwin Machis (Cadiz).
86' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to substitute Iza Carcelen and he is replaced by Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz).
86' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
84' Substitution. Williot Swedberg makes his way off the pitch and Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) comes on as his replacement.
82' Cadiz CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

80' Juanmi (Cadiz) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Vicente Guaita.
78' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) brings an opponent down and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias interrupts the game.
76' Booking. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) receives a caution from the referee.
75' Rafael Benitez prepares a substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
75' The substitution has been made. Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) has replaced Javier Manquillo.
74' The attendance for today's match is 18123.
73' PENALTY APPEAL by Celta Vigo, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
72' Juanmi (Cadiz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias had an easy-decision to make.
71' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.

66' 1 - 2 Sergio Guardiola sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Juanmi (Cadiz) latches on to it and finishes with a quick low shot into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:2.
65' A substitution has been made. Gonzalo Escalante is replaced by Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz).
65' Mauricio Pellegrino decides to make a substitution. Ruben Sobrino will be replaced by Chris Ramos (Cadiz).
65' A substitution has been made. Maximiliano Gomez goes off and Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) comes on.
65' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
63' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Jailson (Celta Vigo). Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
58' 0 - 2 Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) converts a killer cross with a powerful low shot that goes into the middle of the net.
57' Here is a change. Renato Tapia is going off and Rafael Benitez gives the last tactical orders to Jailson (Celta Vigo).
57' Here comes a substitution. Tadeo Allende is given a rest as he is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
56' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
55' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
53' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
50' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Cadiz CF for a penalty. Play continues.
45+3' The resulting corner from Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) is cleared by the defence.
45+2' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) fires the resultant free kick towards the left post, but the keeper makes a brilliant save and denies him the chance to score.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Poor challenge! Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) is penalised for tripping and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle.
39' Juanmi (Cadiz) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Vicente Guaita scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
37' What a miss! The corner finds Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
36' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) steps up to send the ball in.
36' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
33' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) is given a yellow card.
30' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo).
25' That was close by Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
23' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
20' Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) trips an opposition player and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias signals a foul.
17' Juanmi (Cadiz) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.

16' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) neatly controls a decent pass from Luca de la Torre. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. 0:1.
8' A short pass finds Iza Carcelen (Cadiz). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
7' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle as Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
5' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
4' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
4' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Cadiz CF win a corner.
3' Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) commits a foul and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias immediately signals a free kick.
2' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vicente Guaita intercepts the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Cadiz CF will kick-off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias will supervise the game today.
